name: @tty-pt/corm
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for libcorm and Corm Recall Kernel (cormr)

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include native/corm_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,../lib -L/usr/lib -lcorm -o build/Release/corm_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
